All tests use `seedPage` and cover the four acceptance criteria:

- **Closed eye:** the first test visits every route in `e2e/routes.json`. It checks that none of the four `ZQX_*` sentinels appear outside `[data-privacy-allow]`, in visible text or in `title`, `aria-label`, `alt`, `placeholder` and `value` attributes. A second test checks that `/indicators` shows the abbreviation `SON` and no 💤 or 🏃.
- **Open eye:**
  - On `/indicators`, clicking the eye reveals `ZQX_SONO_9K2`, `ZQX_ENERGIA_7F3`, `Exercício`, 💤 and 🏃.
  - Names stay revealed after navigating to another page (via a link matching painel/dashboard/hoje).
  - A second click hides them again.
- **Reload:** after revealing names and reloading, the eye is closed again and no sentinel shows outside the allow-list.
- **Observation note:** `ZQX_OBS_NOTA_5T1` must never appear outside `[data-privacy-allow]`, even with the eye open. It must be visible inside an allow-listed element once the person opens it. I couldn't tell how the note opens, so the test clicks the first button whose name matches observação or nota on `/dashboard`. That selector is a guess the implementation may need to match or the test may need adjusting.

There is also a smoke test that every route opens and renders. It runs on both projects and has no desktop-only skip, so the spec has no `.skip` or `.only`.
